def read_input():
    return list(map(int, raw_input().split()))

def fast_pow(base, exp, mod):
    res = 1
    while exp:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return res

p, k = read_input()
MOD = 1000000007
result = 0
if k == 0:
    result = fast_pow(p, p - 1, MOD)
else:
    for i in range(1, p):
        if (p - 1) % i == 0 and fast_pow(k, i, p) == 1:
            result = fast_pow(p, (p - 1) // i, MOD)
            if k == 1:
                result = (result * p) % MOD
            break
print result
